$comment: Backend-only profile: MCP server + operator/pipeline services, no frontend.
The point of the must_not_touch list is that this profile must be installable
on a machine with no Node.js at all (plan item P1-05).
label: Harness backend + MCP (no WebUI)
description: The DataFlow Harness backend: FastAPI service, MCP server over SSE, operator registry, pipeline validation, plus the MCP-aware workflow skills. Driven from Claude Code / Codex / Cursor — no browser UI.
audience: Users who drive DataFlow from an agent via MCP and never open the canvas.
installs: Harness workflow skills (MCP-aware) and standalone skills
does_not_install: Node.js, npm, or any frontend dependency
The frontend build (frontend/dist) — the canvas will not be served
writes_outside_repo: The chosen skills directory only. Agent MCP config is a separate, explicit command.

steps.label: Initialize the DataFlow core data directory
Render skills for Claude, Codex and Cursor from canonical sources
Copy skills into the target skills directory
Install Cursor, Codex and shared agent assets into this repo

verify.label: MCP server declares its tool whitelist
Every installed skill has a readable SKILL.md
Codex and Cursor assets were generated

next_steps: Point an agent at it: ./install.sh configure-agent --agent claude
Note: the WebUI canvas is intentionally NOT available in this profile
